thread:
Andrew H: Heads-up — planned maintenance for Dedicated control-plane DB migration and config rollout. Target date: 2026-04-02. Initial proposed window: 2026-04-02 02:00–03:00 UTC. Scope: control-plane migration + rolling config push to Dedicated pools (routing table + canary weights). Expected impact: very short (<=60s) routing blips for a small subset of requests while we drain and restart brokers; client retries should succeed. No data loss expected. Posting draft status page banner and customer email below, please review and sign off. I will be primary oncall for the window, @Mira S backup.

Mira S: Ack — quick note from infra: heavy batch job run windows at 02:00 in a few regions. Can we shift later to 04:00–05:00 UTC instead? That avoids interfering with scheduled batch jobs and gives more time for prechecks.

Andrew H: Yep we can shift. New window: 2026-04-02 04:00–05:00 UTC. Please update status/customer templates.

ops-bot: :information_source: Scheduling change recorded: maintenance 1788001234 moved from 2026-04-02 02:00–03:00 UTC to 2026-04-02 04:00–05:00 UTC by Andrew H. Notification queued to channels: #incidents, #announcements, status.redwood.ai draft.

Emma L: Draft status page banner (please copy/paste into the status page editor):

```
Maintenance notice — 2026-04-02 04:00–05:00 UTC (UTC)
We will perform a control-plane database migration and rolling config rollout for Dedicated capacity. During the maintenance window a small percentage of inference requests may experience transient errors (503) or elevated latency (up to ~60s) while brokers drain and restart. We expect automated retries to succeed. No customer data will be affected. Reserved capacity customers should not see capacity loss but may see brief routing adjustments. We will update this page when the maintenance is complete.
```

Emma L: Customer-facing email (short template):

Subject: Upcoming maintenance: Redwood Dedicated — 2026-04-02 04:00–05:00 UTC

Body:
Hi —

We’re scheduling a short maintenance on 2026-04-02 from 04:00–05:00 UTC to perform a control-plane database migration and config rollout for Dedicated capacity. During this window a small fraction of inference requests may see transient errors or latency spikes while we perform rolling restarts; automated retries should succeed. Reserved capacity customers should not lose capacity but may see brief routing adjustments.

No action is required on your side. If you have a hard blackout during this window, reply to this thread and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
The Redwood Inference Team

Ollie K: Add a one-liner for the status page about customer impact for Dedicated reserved vs shared: "Reserved capacity: no capacity loss expected; Shared routing may have brief reroutes." Also, include the rollback plan summary in the runbook link.

Andrew H: Good call. Runbook + rollback: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/dedicated-db-migration (use this link in the status page 'more info'). Short checklist for oncall during window:
- Monitor: /metrics -> control_plane_errors, dedicated_pool_up
- Watch: PagerDuty for SRE escalation
- If errors > 1% sustained for 5m, trigger canary rollback: `rb rollback --deployment dedicated-config-v2` and set routing to previous canary weights.
- Notify customers via status page and #announcements

incident-bot: :calendar: Maintenance created (id: 1788001234) by Andrew H. Window: 2026-04-02 04:00–05:00 UTC. Channels: #incidents, #announcements, #eng-oncall.

Mira S: Oncall handoff notes — I'll be on standby starting 03:30 UTC, taking over if you need to step out. Escalation path: Olli -> Platform Eng Manager -> PagerDuty emergency. I'll have SSH access to the control-plane bastion.

Andrew H: Thanks. Quick pre-checks I'll run at 03:45 UTC: snapshot control-plane DB, verify schema migration in staging, confirm canary rollback script is tested.

ops-bot: :warning: Reminder: maintenance 1788001234 starts in 60 minutes (2026-04-02 03:00 UTC) — automated pre-checks will run at 03:45 UTC.

--- (later, during window) ---

Andrew H: Starting migration now (2026-04-02 04:05 UTC). Rolling drain of brokers initiated. I'll post progress updates here.

incident-bot: :arrow_forward: Migration step 1/4 complete: schema dump verified. Step 2/4 applying migration to control-plane DB - canary region.

Andrew H: Canary region migration applied, monitoring for 10m. No elevated errors observed so far (control_plane_errors steady). Proceeding to roll across remaining regions.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary passed. Proceeding to full rollout.

Mira S: Observed a small bump in p95 latency in us-west for 30s during a broker restart but no request failures. Watching logs.

Andrew H: Noted. Continuing.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Migration and config rollout complete across all Dedicated pools at 04:42 UTC. Post-upgrade checks: control_plane_errors = 0.01% (within baseline), dedicated_pool_up = true.

Andrew H: Maintenance complete. Final status page update draft: 

```
Maintenance complete — 2026-04-02 04:42 UTC
The control-plane database migration and Dedicated config rollout have completed successfully. A small number of requests experienced transient latency or retries during broker restarts; automated retries handled most cases. Reserved capacity customers did not experience capacity loss. If you continue to see issues, contact support@redwood.ai and mention maintenance id 1788001234.
```

Emma L: Posted final update to status.redwood.ai and sent customer follow-up email.

ops-bot: :tada: Maintenance 1788001234 marked complete by Andrew H at 2026-04-02 04:42 UTC. Notifications sent to channels and subscribers.

Ollie K: Good job. I'll run a quick sanity sweep for the next 2 hours and then we can close the oncall watch.

Andrew H: Thanks everyone — leaving the thread open for 2 hours for any post-maint followups.

incident-bot: :lock: Thread will auto-close in 120 minutes unless a new message is posted.
